svg.title: Token usage
svg.desc: Daily token usage for the last 52 weeks as a heatmap (days without usage shown as zero): week index on the x-axis, day of week on the y-axis, values normalized to 0–1 and coloured with the matplotlib Oranges colormap, with 13,699,861,083 tokens used in total as of November 09, 2026.
svg.text: All-time token usage: 13,699,861,083 as of November 09, 2026
